Name: Blahaj Crop
Author: WrenTheRowoyal
Description:
It's pride month! (At least at the time I'm uploading this), and what better way to celebrate than a blahaj mod?


Adds a new plant, the Blahaj Fruit Plant.

Seeds can be purchased from Pierre's.

Takes 5 days to grow, and can be grown in every season but winter.

Also adds a new item, the Blahaj Plush Scarecrow, which can be bought from Willy's shop.

Requires JSON Assets and SMAPI.

Downloads.Description:
Blahaj Crop!!!

Made the Seeds more expensive, and changed it to a Universal Like, instead of a Love. Seb and Abigail still love it, and George is neutral.
Fixed the bug that made it regrow. It will no longer turn invisible on harvest and regrow.
